spans.s: Īśvaraguṇāparājitadhvaja, n. of a Tathāgata: Gv 〔380.22〕; later, in vs, called Īśvarājitaguṇadhvaja, 〔383.14〕.
Īśvaragupta, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.141.4〕.
Īśvaradeva, n. of (apparently) two Bodhisattvas (in the same list! is one an error?): Gv 〔442.8, 10〕.

īśvarīya, nt. (= Pali issariya, AMg. id. or īsariya; penultimate ī may be m.c.), sovereignty: Mv 〔ii.395.6〕 (vs) na tasya ko pi (by em.; one ms. vī) jane īśvarīyam The Śikṣ parallel, 〔308.4〕, has īśvaratvaṃ.
